answers.answer: 上限は250語です。文献引用を入れてはいけません。
answers.basis: An abstract of no more than 250 words is required. The abstract must not include references.
A list of up to five keywords should be provided below the abstract.

answers.answer: 50文字以内（スペースを含む）で、3ページ目以降の奇数ページのヘッダーに必要です。
answers.basis: At the header on each odd page from page 3, a Running Title not exceeding 50 characters including spaces is required

answers.answer: 括弧（[ ]）で囲み、句点やカンマの前に配置します。例：[1,3,5-8]
answers.basis: When cited in the text, reference numbers must be put in brackets in the form [1,3,5-8] before a ‘period’ or a ‘comma’.

answers.answer: 最初の6名までを記載し、その後に「et al.」を付けます。
answers.basis: For more than six authors, list the first six authors followed by “et al.”:

answers.answer: 通常の図はTIFF、PNG、JPEG、PDF形式で解像度300dpiです。グラフィカルアブストラクトはPNG、JPEG、GIF形式で解像度300dpiです。
answers.basis: We accept figure files in TIFF, PNG, JPEG or PDF formats. / The format of the graphical abstract should be PNG, JPEG or GIF, and the resolution should be 300 dpi.

answers.answer: ①本文中で必ず言及すること。②出現順にアラビア数字で通し番号を振ること。③表の上部に見出し題を、下部にアルファベット順の脚注を付け、縦線を使わないこと。
answers.basis: All tables must be cited in the text. / Number the tables consecutively with Arabic numerals (for example “Table 3”), in the order of their appearance in the text. / Do not use vertical lines.

answers.answer: 上限は20MBです。超える場合は、J-STAGE Dataなどの関連データリポジトリにアップロードし、編集局に連絡する必要があります。
answers.basis: The size of each file that is uploaded using the online submission system such as text, tables, figures and supplementary material (if any), should be no more than 20 MB. / When the supplementary materials are larger than 20 MB, please upload them to another relating BPPB data repository, J-STAGE Data... In this case, please contact the Editorial office.

answers.answer: 「New」「Novel」「First」「Unprecedented」やそれらの形容詞、および類似の記述語は使えません。
answers.basis: Titles and abstracts of manuscripts may not contain the positive words: “New”, “Novel”, “First”, “Unprecedented”, or other similar descriptive words, and their adjectives.
Authors who have been requested to revise their manuscript should send the revised version to the handling editor within 90 days of receiving the editorial decision.
